set.body: Define workspace_bytes as effectagram-owned planned live memory and, if retained, a separately observable aggregate RSS limit. Account for dense versus sparse frame storage, resident sources and handles, response/relation blocks, atoms, component-dependent local state, outputs, contraction/replacement copies, and active buffers. Search legal feature, row, and coordinate tiles for a fitting plan rather than failing at fixed defaults. Benchmarks must separately report baseline RSS, incremental RSS, absolute peak RSS, and planned workspace.
set.title: Implement budget-driven tiling and truthful memory semantics
